notes.title: ODEN Launch Sale in Progress! New Asset Pack DLC Available Now!
notes.notes:
Greetings from the ODEN team!

How are you enjoying your visit to our oden cart?
Our special launch discount ends March 13th - don't miss your chance to savor the experience while it's hot!

We're thrilled to introduce our Creator Support DLC, packed with game assets for both creative enthusiasts and oden lovers.
This collection features original artwork and soundtrack elements straight from the game.
There are no restrictions - use these assets anywhere, customize them to your heart's content, and create something uniquely yours!
